first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: An adult man with side-parted brown hair and a thin handlebar mustache, wearing a dark purple jacket, white shirt, gray vest, black bow tie, and light gray trousers, and holding a notepad and pen.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A young man wearing a dark purple stand-collar uniform and a purple cylindrical hat with gold lettering, following closely behind Person A.

entities.name: red patterned carpet
entities.identification: The red-based carpet in the lobby passage and seating area, with light-colored edging and repeated floral-cluster patterns.

entities.name: large potted palm
entities.identification: The tall cluster of dark green palm fronds on the left side of the lobby; pinnate fronds and the planter below them are visible in the first segment.

entities.name: Person E
entities.identification: A man on the left, wearing a dark tall hat and a long purple uniform and holding a light-colored bouquet against his chest.

entities.name: cream-pink wall and arched niche
entities.identification: The light warm-pink lobby wall, with rectangular decorative outlines and arched areas.

entities.name: golden-brown stone-faced column
entities.identification: The tall golden-brown column on the left in the first segment, with irregular light and dark textures and vertical divisions.

entities.name: warm-white globe lights and wall lights
entities.identification: The group of light fixtures in the lobby comprising spherical pendant lights, small bulbs along the arch edges, and wall-mounted lights.

entities.name: wood-framed upholstered chair in the lobby
entities.identification: The group of chairs in the seating area with brown frames, light-colored or brown upholstery, and slender legs.

entities.name: guests and staff in the background
entities.identification: The group of background people in the distant passage and seating area, including, in the final segment, a person in a white apron in front of the doorway and a person in dark clothing on the right.

entities.name: metallic round flowerpot
entities.identification: The brown-and-gold cylindrical planter below the palm on the left in the first segment.

entities.name: light-colored bouquet held by the attendant
entities.identification: The clustered ivory-white flowers and dark green leaves held against Person E's chest.

entities.name: light-colored ceiling
entities.identification: The light warm-colored upper surface of the lobby, with rectangular sections and decorative lines.

entities.name: floor pattern band
entities.identification: The continuous narrow pattern band of alternating light and dark elements arranged along the side edge of the red patterned carpet, limited to the area visible in the image.
